comments.note: computeHandoffStatus is a clean 10-line wrapper — correct separation of concerns: lives in workflow-handoff.ts (its home), consumed by workflow-next-action.ts. One-way import, no circular dependency risk.

embedHandoffStatusInWait gracefully degrades: if computeHandoffStatus throws, the error is embedded as handoff_status_error instead of propagating. This correctly prevents a secondary computation failure from blocking the primary WAIT response.

workflow-next-action.ts switch: 'Planner' role is not an explicit case and falls through to the default WAIT branch. This is correct, but a comment such as '// Planner falls through to default WAIT' would make the intent explicit for future readers.

computeHandoffStatus creates a new LedgerStore (extra root-index + WP reads) on each WAIT return. Acceptable since WAIT is the terminal end-of-work path. Future optimization: thread pre-loaded wpDetails through to eliminate the round-trip. Developer-flagged.
